old_problem: Pending items were idle/power thresholds, monitoring cadence and reversible environment/power-policy settings.
disposition_reason: ED-03 permits runtime idle/monitor bindings, ED-09 keeps chamber work manual, ED-14 preserves 24 hours, ED-15 requires signed idle/power/event limits, and ED-17 preserves baseline evidence.
decision_basis: Direct XLSX row64 all 18 columns, same-row DeepSeek, history3097 and actual next row65/history3098 were read.
Utilization/power/background bounds and continuous heartbeat prove awake true-idle rather than hidden sleep/reboot.
Hibernate/sleep changes require original-state evidence and rollback.
Power-state/reachability/events are correlated to dry 0C/-5% telemetry; no soak ran.

test_case.purpose: Verify continuous stable awake-idle behavior at cold/low-rail margin without unintended sleep/wake, reboot, hang, management loss or platform event.
test_case.test_command: Qualified staff establish dry 0C/-5% conditions, apply only approved reversible power settings, maintain the untouched system for 24 hours with heartbeat, utilization, power-state, sensor, reachability and event telemetry, then restore settings and nominal environment.
test_case.expected_result: The system remains awake/reachable within signed idle bounds for 24 hours with expected power states, no disallowed event and successful rollback/restoration.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the complete timeline and settings rollback; final reachability, hidden sleep/reboot or missing idle proof cannot pass.
safety_gate: Qualified chamber/rail operator and OOB heartbeat
Abort on reachability, moisture, electrical, thermal or severe-event limit
test_case.recovery: Stop on a limit, preserve the state/outage timeline, restore nominal rails, warm/dry, recover services and original settings, and do not restart automatically.

source_conflict.reason: Sources align on 24-hour idle cold/low-rail soak.
